title: Corrected Mob Heads
description: Tweaks how mob heads appear in first-person and third-person perspectives.
body:
![Showcases the difference in how mob heads appear with this pack in first-person perspective](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbbda55d5ad65898bcf9c874be89450467f3c523.webp)

![Showcases the difference in how mob heads appear with this pack in third-person perspective](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6debec0ec63b621280b8dcd626f0ecfbd7578921.webp)


This small project was inspired by [MC-91869](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-91869) on the bug tracker and wanted to make this based on the screenshots on there. The files of the fixes that are currently on there do not work on the latest versions, and I wanted to share a working version of that. This pack makes mob heads look more distinguishable and recognizable in first person and third person view.

Also, I will not be making a version for 1.8 since models work differently in that version of the game.
